note: Total gzip size, bytes, of the JS chunks index.html loads on first paint — the entry chunk plus anything it modulepreloads. ADR 0014's promise is that the three.js sail view does not land on first load; `bundle_check.mjs` is what makes that promise checkable. Raise this deliberately, in the PR that earns it, never to make CI green — and if the number jumps by tens of kilobytes, something that should be behind a dynamic import is not.

ux-03 M-23: the honesty markdown and the secondary screens leave the first load. −41330 B against this branch's HEAD, which builds at 134066 B here (23 B above the 134043 recorded for desktop-kite phase 05). Three things left: PROVENANCE.md, ASSUMPTIONS.md and validation/report.md are now `await import('...?raw')` inside More's document sheet, so the 48 KB raw / 21.1 KB gzip of markdown is three chunks (12.0 + 6.2 + 2.9 KB gzip) nobody fetches until they tap a document link; Log, Drills and More are `{#await import()}` in App.svelte the way Kit already was, for 6.0 + 4.1 + 4.1 KB gzip of screens plus an 11.1 KB shared `store.svelte` chunk. Rollup now emits four first-load chunks rather than one (index, settings.svelte, InstrumentCell, Toast), so `bundle_check.mjs` sums every chunk index.html names instead of asserting there is exactly one; it is the same first-load payload measured the same way, and splitting a screen out only counts if it leaves that set. phase-two 02 merged onto 03/#94: phase-two phase 02, share and compare (ADR 0019). +3107 B over this branch's HEAD, which builds at 94419 B here — 1683 B above the 92736 recorded at ux-03 M-23, so a third of the +4790 B the gate reported against the committed baseline is main drifting since that measurement rather than this change. Of the 3107 B, roughly half is code (`ui/share.ts`: the versioned codec, its migration table and the control-group validators; `components/CopyLink.svelte`; the pin state and its ghost outline in `race/PlanView.svelte`) and roughly half is Rollup regrouping: `share.ts` is now imported by the entry alongside `conditions.svelte` and `dock/logic`, so `data/boats/j70.json` (6.0 KB) and `data/tuning/north-j70.json` (3.2 KB) stop being inlined in the index chunk and become preloaded shared chunks, which the sum counts at their standalone gzip size rather than compressed against 70 KB of neighbouring JS. The same bytes go over the wire, measured less kindly. Nothing crossed the lazy boundary: the 3D ghost outline is built inside SailView3D, which is unchanged at 139.2 KB gzip and still not precached, and the Log screen passes `CopyLink` a `ShareState` rather than importing `share.ts`, so its chunk keeps no second copy of the boat file. Re-measured after merging main (which had moved to 95286 with #94): 97482 B, i.e. +2196 B for this change on top of the guide work.

phase-two 05 step 1–3: the core takes the boat, not the J/70. +3378 B over 97482 (main itself sat at 97612 after #99). The boat registry (`src/lib/boat.ts`) attaches the ORC polar to the BoatDefinition at load and the settings store validates the stored boat id against that registry, so the polar JSON and the loader join the entry; `validateBoat` grew to cover every field the solver reads. First-load data by design: the picker and the share `boat=` param need the registry before the first solve. Follow-up on the phase: thirteen UI files still import `data/boats/j70.json` directly — repointing them to the registry is expected to shrink this, and the number should be re-measured then rather than treated as a floor.
